#### Get Started

# Enterprise account unification

Existing Enterprise customers are not moved automatically. Your current plan, seats, billing, single sign-on, and user provisioning continue.

Some Enterprise organizations can choose to unify. Contact your account team to see if your organization is eligible, or to make changes to your plan.

## What stays the same

* Your organization is not moved automatically.
* Your current plan, seats, and billing continue. Contact your account team to make changes.
* Existing single sign-on and user provisioning remain in place. Follow guidance from your account team for changes.
* Sign-in domains may change; confirm network allowlists with IT before you unify (see [Which domains does Cursor sign-in need?](/x-subscription/sign-in-domains)).

## Network access

If your company uses a firewall or proxy allowlist, ask IT to allow the hosts in [Which domains does Cursor sign-in need?](/x-subscription/sign-in-domains) (including [accounts.x.ai](https://accounts.x.ai/) and related [x.ai](https://x.ai/) and [grok.com](https://grok.com/) hosts). Follow any extra guidance from your account team.
